journey.name: Resync Subscriptions to Test Mode
journey.description: Validates that a Super Admin can trigger a live-to-test subscription resync from the billing operations page, view the live mode notice and confirmation prompt, and inspect the count of resynced subscriptions.

story.title: Super admin trigger subscription replication to test backend
Display resynced count and handle errors

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard as a Super Admin and navigate to '/dashboard/billing/operations'.
Verify the 'Resync Subscriptions to Test Mode' card is visible (and hidden for non-super admins).
Verify the informational notice explains that this replicates active live subscription records to the test database so sandbox storefronts mirror production plans.
Verify a confirmation modal appears with a warning that the action contacts the test backend and replicates store plans.
Verify a success alert or toast reports the number of merchant subscriptions replicated.
